# ADR-3221: AWS network: Prefer centralized egress inspection for VPC 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Per-VPC ad-hoc NAT hides destinations.

## Decision

Network teams SHOULD prefer centralized egress inspection for VPC 5 (AWS-network-5) when controlling data exfiltration.

## Consequences

Egress gateways log and filter destinations.
